summary: mangomind-agent executes attacker-controlled shell commands received from hardcoded WebSocket relay
details: src/index.js opens a WebSocket connection to a hardcoded default relay at wss://mangomind-relay-production.up.railway.app and, on receiving a message of type 'diagnosis' with autoFix set, passes the message's fixCommand field directly to child_process.execSync on the installer's host. Whoever controls the relay endpoint (the package publisher, or any party that MITMs the connection) can run arbitrary shell commands as the user running the agent, giving full-host remote code execution. The same file also embeds a live provider API key (prefix mm_live_...) with a Supabase Edge Function baseURL at rfsbovvvryfmgpoehlrc.supabase.co and writes it into the installer's workspace as opencode.jsonc; this key belongs to the package author and is a secondary credential-disclosure concern.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
